units.source_text: 列席观战的小野田六段等人也敬佩地说：

en.t: Onoda, 6-dan, and the others present watching the match also said admiringly:

units.source_text: 如果说黑69的进攻是绝着，那么白70也是凌厉的高着。

en.t: If Black 69's attack was a brilliant move, then White 70 was also a sharp and masterful move.

units.source_text: 成败在此一举，但名人渡过了难关。

en.t: Success or failure hinged on this one move, but the Meijin made it through the crisis.

units.source_text: 名人忍了一步，摆脱了厄运。

en.t: The Meijin endured for one move and escaped misfortune.

units.source_text: 这大概是十分艰苦的高着吧。

en.t: This was probably an extremely difficult master move.

units.source_text: 白子以这一手挫败了黑子猛攻过来的气势。

en.t: With this move, White checked the momentum of Black's fierce assault.

units.source_text: 看来黑子只是虚张声势，白子避免受伤，变得一身轻了。

en.t: It seemed that Black had only been bluffing; White avoided damage and became free of burden.
